# Security

Deckdelve runs offline. It opens no network connection, and all it writes is its own settings and saved run. That leaves little to attack, but a flaw is still worth reporting: a saved run or a theme file that makes the game do more than crash, for example.

## Reporting a problem

Please don't open a public issue for it. Use [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/orumcan/Deckdelve/security/advisories/new), which keeps the report private on GitHub, or write to orumcan@gmail.com.

Say which version and platform you found it on and how to reproduce it. You'll get an answer as soon as possible, usually within a week. The fix goes into the next release, and its notes credit you unless you'd rather they didn't.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets fixes.
